description: Chaotic signal generator running five two-parameter maps, at audio rate, as modulation, or stepped from an external clock

params.text: Sets how often a new value is generated; these maps are not periodic, so this is a rate rather than a pitch
Attenuverter for the Sample Rate CV input, -1 to +1
Sets the first of the two parameters driving the selected map
Attenuverter for the Chaos A CV input, -1 to +1
Sets the second of the two parameters driving the selected map
Attenuverter for the Chaos B CV input, -1 to +1
Selects the map: Cusp, Gauss, Henon, Hetrick or Mouse
Attenuverter for the Mode CV input, -1 to +1
Fast runs the generator across its full rate range; Slow divides that rate by 100 for modulation speeds
Stepped jumps to each new value; Slewed interpolates linearly between values, which doubles as a low-pass filter at audio rates
DC passes the output as generated; AC strips any DC offset out of it
Inserts fresh random values into the map, restarting it when it has settled or gone silent

inputs.text: A rising edge here generates one new value, replacing the internal rate clock
A rising edge here restarts the map with fresh random values
Modulates the generation rate, scaled by the Sample Rate attenuverter
Modulates the first map parameter, scaled by the Chaos A attenuverter
Modulates the second map parameter, scaled by the Chaos B attenuverter
Modulates the map selection, scaled by the Mode attenuverter

outputs.text: The map's second dimension, -5V to 5V; on the one-dimensional maps this carries the negation of Out X

notes: the generation rate is set as a fraction of the patch's own sample rate, so changing the patch's sample rate changes the speed and the sound of what comes out.
